# Oiyo — Knowledge Layer (Execution)

> Interactive tools and tests across personality, saju, astrology, tarot, numerology and wellness. The execution layer of the Oiyo knowledge network. Languages: en, ko, ja, fr, es, zh.

## Machine-readable catalogs
- [Tools catalog](https://oiyo.net/knowledge/tools.json): schema.org ItemList of interactive tools/tests — category, languages and a stable URL.
- [Discovery manifest](https://oiyo.net/knowledge/index.json): resources, the canonical cross-site concept graph, and the Oiyo knowledge network.

## Overview
- [Knowledge hub](https://oiyo.net/knowledge/): human-readable overview.

## Citation
Cite individual tools by their stable URL (see tools.json `url`). Attribution: Oiyo (oiyo.net).

## Network
- Definition: https://wiki.oiyo.net
- Explanation: https://blog.oiyo.net
- Execution: https://oiyo.net
- Gaming: https://game.oiyo.net
- Curation: https://news.oiyo.net
- AX Showcase: https://ai.oiyo.net

## Machine-readable identity
- [brand-facts.json](https://oiyo.net/brand-facts.json): organization identity (shared @id), the 6-site network (definition/explanation/execution/gaming/curation/ax-showcase), locales, and citation guidance.
